scope: Make the closure screen display readiness for atomic joint participant groups, not isolated company units.
finding: A participant's company unit could be shown as ready while another unit linked by a joint task was blocked by an independent active clock. The domain closure remained atomic, but the screen's ready count and confirmation text overstated what could close.
changes: Exposed the domain grouping of transitively connected company closure units to the closure manager.
A group is shown ready only when every open unit in the connected group passes its blocker checks.
If a connected group has a previously closed unit and still-open units, the open units require review instead of being offered for closure.
The confirmation uses only units from fully ready groups; the domain revalidates the group during commit.
Updated the explanatory copy to distinguish blocked joint groups from independent groups that can still close.

regression.case: One member's separate active clock marks both linked company units pending and excludes both from the ready count.
